description: Implement serialization (DTOs, JSON, Unity serializers) and persistence (database, CQRS) for domain models (C# by default, F# on request) following "Domain Modeling Made Functional." Use this skill whenever creating DTOs, converting between domain types and serializable types, implementing fromDomain/toDomain functions, persisting domain objects, or designing database schemas for algebraic types. Trigger on: "DTO", "data transfer object", "serialize", "deserialize", "fromDomain", "toDomain", "JSON", "persist", "database", "CQRS", "command query separation", "read model", "write model", "document database", "relational mapping", "choice type to table", "push I/O to edges", "persistence layer", "repository", "event sourcing". Also trigger when the user has a domain model and needs to bridge it to infrastructure (APIs, databases, queues, external services).
